name: Take Kingdom By Force
overview: Scripture reveals that the kingdom of God is established by the sovereign God of heaven and is eternal, destined to supplant all earthly kingdoms (Daniel 2:44). The saints of the Most High are promised to take and possess this kingdom forever, especially at the time of divine judgment (Daniel 7:18, 22). The kingdom is described as being forcefully advanced, with those who are determined pressing into it and taking it by force since the days of John the Baptist (Matthew 11:12; Luke 16:16). However, Jesus warns that the kingdom can be removed from those who fail to bear its fruits and given to a faithful people (Matthew 21:43).
